classifier: mechanical telemetry only; no model classification
notes: t_delivered is session start. The initial ATOMIC snapshot or COMPILED projection is already in the system prompt.
After delivery, TaskView reads of subsumed relations, catalog describes, and targeted describes of those relations are reassembly.
describe(relation='migration_surface') rereads the delivered presentation and is not atomic-relation reassembly.
SOURCE_READ of required_local_files is never reassembly.
SOURCE_READ of repository_support_files is reassembly of already-compiled coarse state.
SOURCE_SEARCH of repository root is reassembly.
From phase 4 onward, verified_by and verification_gap are reassessment, not reassembly.
